title: UE-initiated de-registration procedure completion for 5GS services over 3GPP access

entities.name: UE-initiated de-registration procedure for 3GPP access
entities.description: Procedure for UE-initiated de-registration from 5GS services over 3GPP access, involving PDU session release and state transitions.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate de-registration procedure.

entities.name: Access type
entities.description: Information element indicating the access type (3GPP, non-3GPP, or both) for de-registration.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: 5GMM state indicating the UE is de-registered for 3GPP access.

entities.name: 5GMM-NULL
entities.description: 5GMM state indicating no NAS signaling connection exists.

entities.name: De-registration for 3GPP access
entities.description: Condition where access type indicates de-registration is for 3GPP access.

entities.name: UE supports N1 mode only and de-registration not due to switch off
entities.description: Condition where UE supports only N1 mode and de-registration is not due to switch off.

entities.name: De-registration due to disabling of 5GS services
entities.description: Condition where de-registration procedure was performed due to disabling of 5GS services.

entities.name: UE marked as inactive for 5GS services over 3GPP access
entities.description: Property where UE is marked as inactive in AMF for 5GS services over 3GPP access.

entities.name: Local release of PDU sessions
entities.description: Property where UE and network perform local release of PDU sessions established over 3GPP access.

entities.name: MA PDU session release
entities.description: Property where Multi-Access PDU sessions are released on 3GPP access or locally released.

relations.description: De-registration procedure involves sending DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message contains access type information element.
Access type IE guards the condition for 3GPP access de-registration.
Condition of 3GPP access de-registration establishes local release of PDU sessions.
Condition of 3GPP access de-registration establishes MA PDU session release.
Condition of 3GPP access de-registration establishes UE marked as inactive.
Condition of 3GPP access de-registration establishes 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state in AMF.
Condition of N1 mode only and not switch off guards de-registration due to disabling 5GS services.
Condition of de-registration due to disabling 5GS services establishes 5GMM-NULL state.
Condition of N1 mode only and not switch off (not due to disabling 5GS) establishes 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
